evidence: The route connects the West Matukituki Valley with the Dart Valley.
DOC recommends trampers begin from the Matukituki side as ascending is much safer than descending.
### Raspberry Creek car park to Aspiring Hut
Follow the West Matukituki Track to Aspiring Hut.
Walk out via the Rees or Dart Valleys on the Rees-Dart Track.

doubts: No road-end features: the Raspberry Creek car park start has no entry, so null. The end is only 'road end' after walking out 'via the Rees or Dart Valleys' on the Rees-Dart Track, so which road end is not stated; null. The text says the route veers off 'just before you reach Cascade Saddle', so the saddle itself may not be walked over; the order of Cascade Creek and the saddle follows the text. The Snowy Creek bridge ref assumes 'the creek' is Snowy Creek. The route can also be done in reverse from the Rees-Dart Track (strongly discouraged); not recorded as a separate way.
